original_issue: Draft does not explicitly explain a simplified-model disposition/limits.
independent_disposition: Final clarification supported; critic severity not independently established as a material error.
reason: Plan asks for limits of any simplified model, not a mandatory model or execution. Draft already says no model was run and lists missing inputs. Explicitly bounding any future sensitivity illustration is useful; accepting it introduces no fabricated inputs, required computation or scope reduction.

original_issue: Draft thermal endpoint referred to deviation from a product-specific quality target.
reason: Temperature and quality are different variables. Final names temperature endpoints and an optional pre-agreed crop-specific thermal criterion separately from quality measurements; neither is derived from loose logger air.

original_issue: Draft package-comparison shorthand could imply a 42% isolated package effect.
reason: Publisher abstract compares similarly sized Nova mandarins in Opentop cartons and Eureka lemons in Supervent cartons at pallet outflow. Both fruit type and carton vary. Final preserves airflow/wrapping discovery while rejecting package-only/local effect interpretation.

original_issue: Case inputs, thresholds/cost/permission and independently verifiable elapsed-window evidence are absent.
independent_disposition: Necessary owner/local choices legitimately remain open; protocol/time judged separately from source correctness.
reason: No data are supplied from which crop, timings, quality target or budget can be inferred. Recorded native lifecycle/time fields now exist in the arm package but are not independently authenticated execution or billing telemetry. They are reported below without changing the bounded source judgment.
